name: Proven Handaxe
description: A close-fighting axe with an elven-forged head and a Silverbark Ash haft, given to those who survive a wild proving. The haft absorbs impact shock more cleanly than realm hardwoods, reducing hand fatigue across a long day's work. Each axe is marked discreetly on the underside of the haft with a sigil recognizable to the giver's house.
narrative_effects: Carries the same mechanics as a standard handaxe.
The Silverbark haft absorbs impact shock more cleanly than dense realm hardwoods, reducing hand fatigue across a long day's work.

Not bought. A Proven Handaxe is given by a house or elder to an elf who has survived a formal or informal proving; the axe itself carries no magical property, but its presence on a person's belt is a visible statement of proving-status recognized across Feywood culture.
